31 July से होगा Form Correction शुरू ✅

RSSB Female Supervisor Correction Form 2026

  • Correction Start Date : 31 July 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 06 August 2026
  • Total : 72 Posts
  • Exam Date : 24 July 2026
  • Advt. No. : 02/2026

Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the Correction Form Notice for Female Supervisor / Mahila Supervisor recruitment (72 posts) under Women & Child Development.

अभ्यर्थी 31 July 2026 से 06 August 2026 तक आवेदन में सुधार (Correction) कर सकते हैं। Correction Charge ₹300 है।

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date : 07 January 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date : 11 February 2026 (Extended)
  • Last Date For Fee Payment : 11 February 2026
  • Correction Date : 31 July – 06 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 24 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 16 July 2026
  • Admit Card : 20 July 2026 (Available)
  • Result Date : Will Be Updated Soon

Application / Correction Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC (Creamy Layer) : ₹600/-
  • EWS, OBC (Non Creamy Layer) : ₹400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : ₹400/-
  • Correction Charge : ₹300/-

Age Limit (as on 01 January 2027)

  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 40 Years

Vacancy Details

Post NameNo. Of PostEligibility
Female Supervisor72Any Graduation + Computer Course + RSSB CET (Graduation Level) 2024 passed

Selection Process

  1. Written Exam
  2. Document Verification
  3. Medical Examination

How to Fill Correction Form

  1. Visit https://rssb.rajasthan.gov.in / SSO https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in
  2. Open Female Supervisor Correction link (activates 31 July 2026)
  3. Login with enrollment / registration / SSO details
  4. Edit allowed fields carefully
  5. Pay correction charge ₹300 if required
  6. Submit on or before 06 August 2026
  7. Print corrected form for records

Correction window: 31 July 2026 to 06 August 2026. Always verify final dates and process from the official RSSB notice.
